# Artifact catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/artifacts.py render. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every schema-versioned artifact the platform reads or writes, grouped by research stage and kept in `research/registry/artifacts.json` (updated 2026-11-18). `scripts/artifacts.py check` fails when code declares a schema id that is not listed here or when a producer or consumer path does not exist. Ids that appear only in closed-study evidence under `docs/tasks/evidence` are not catalogued.

Authority is `authoritative` for the source of truth and `view` for a derived rendering. Status is `implemented`, `planned` (named by the plan that will build it), `template-only` (a fill-in file with no schema id) or `frozen-study-specific` (a one-study format kept only so old evidence stays readable).
